reports.title: Time of day: when the entry fires, and what it's worth
reports.summary: 21 days, 787 triggered setups. Within the pre-market no window is statistically distinguishable from another — but entries decay monotonically through the session, after 11:00 significantly so, and R-normalisation hides a large percentage-move effect.
